d:
Lok aastha ke char divsiy mahaparv chhath puja aur kharna ke pavan avsar par rajdhani patna men bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ke rashtriy adhyaksh nitin navin ne is mahaparv ki samajik samrasta aur vishishtata par apne vichar sajha kie hain. unhonne kaha ki kharna puja aur chhath mahaparv ki sabse bari khasiyat yahi hai ki yahan har aam aur khas vyakti ke lie bhagvan ki puja ki paddhati aur aashirvad ek saman hota hai.
'isi samanta ke karan bihar ki is sanskriti ko pure desh aur duniya men sthan mila'
